nav.review_count: {count, plural, one {# answer to review} other {# answers to review}}

thread.answers: {count, plural, =0 {No answers yet} one {# answer} other {# answers}}
thread.no_answers: Nobody has answered yet. Know the answer? Share it below.
thread.hint: Answers should answer the question. To ask for more detail or say thanks, add a comment under the question or an answer.
thread.duplicate_of: This question was closed as a duplicate of:
thread.linked: {count, plural, one {A question was closed as a duplicate of this one:} other {# questions were closed as duplicates of this one:}}

post.rep_title: {count, plural, one {# reputation point in this tag} other {# reputation points in this tag}}

comments.more: {count, plural, one {Show # more comment} other {Show # more comments}}
comments.placeholder: Ask for more detail or suggest an improvement
comments.left: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}

bounty.title: Start a bounty
bounty.help_rep: Taken from your reputation in this tag now. It isn't given back if nobody earns it.
bounty.help_money: Taken from your balance now. It isn't given back if nobody earns it.
bounty.rules: Runs for {days} days. The accepted answer gets it all; if none is accepted, the top-voted answer posted during the bounty with at least 2 votes gets half.
bounty.rule: The accepted answer gets it; otherwise the top-voted answer (2+ votes) posted during the bounty gets half.

close.title: Close as a duplicate
close.help: Find the question this one repeats. A moderator closes it right away; otherwise it closes when enough trusted members agree.
close.search_placeholder: Search question titles, or paste a link

suggest.title: Suggest an edit
suggest.help: Your edit goes to reviewers, and is applied when they approve it.
suggest.summary_placeholder: Fixed the code, added a link…
suggest.sent: Thanks! Your edit was sent for review.

review.title: Review answers
review.empty: Nothing to review here. Thanks for helping!
review.denied: Reviewing needs more reputation in a Q&A tag.
review.outdated: The answer was edited after this suggestion was made, so it wasn't applied.

notification.bounty: Your answer won a {amount} reputation bounty

tag.enable_help: Replies become answers sorted by votes, each with its own comments, and the asker can accept one.

settings.intro: Turn a tag into Q&A from its edit dialog on the Tags page. These settings apply to every Q&A tag. Who may vote, edit, review and close is set per tag under Permissions.
settings.import_help: FoF Best Answer is installed. Import its Q&A tags and best answers as Q&A tags and accepted answers (safe to run again; Best Answer's data is only read).
settings.import_done: Done: {tags} Q&A tags, {questions} questions, {accepted} answers accepted.
settings.gamification: Also count votes in FoF Gamification
settings.gamification_help: When FoF Gamification is enabled, each vote is also cast there, so its points, ranks and leaderboard include it. Its own vote buttons are hidden on questions.
settings.edit_reputation: Reputation needed to edit others' answers
settings.edit_reputation_help: In one of the question's Q&A tags, on top of the permission. Moderators need none.
settings.review_reputation: Reputation needed to review and vote to close
settings.review_reputation_help: In one of the question's Q&A tags, on top of the permission. Moderators need none.
settings.review_approvals_help: How many reviewers settle a review item. A moderator settles it alone.
settings.close_votes: Votes to close as a duplicate
settings.close_votes_help: Trusted members who must name the same original. A moderator closes it alone.
settings.low_quality_length_help: Answers shorter than this many characters (links left out) go to the review queue.
settings.bounty_min_age_days: Days before a question can get a bounty

permissions.close: Vote to close duplicates (with enough reputation)
permissions.moderate: Moderate questions (accept, close and edit without reputation)

api.not_an_answer: Only an answer can be accepted.
api.bounty_running: This question already has a bounty.
api.not_enough: You don't have enough for that bounty.
api.closed: This question is solved or closed, so it can't get a bounty.
api.too_new: A question can get a bounty after it has been open a little while.
api.closed_as_duplicate: This question was closed as a duplicate, so it takes no new answers. You can still comment.
api.unchanged: Change something before sending the edit.
api.already_suggested: You already have an edit waiting for review on this answer.

gdpr.export: Your votes on questions and answers, and your reputation and its history.
gdpr.anonymize: Your votes and reputation stay, no longer under your name.
gdpr.delete: Your votes come off every score, and your reputation is deleted.
